name: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
description: A reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the front, working leg, followed by a high knee with the stepping leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell on the same side as the leg that will stay in front, and stand tall.
Step backward with the opposite leg and lower into a controlled lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand, then drive the stepping leg forward into a high knee.
Regain your balance, repeat, then switch the kettlebell and leg sides.
